laws.rule: Škocjan Caves (UNESCO): guided tour adult €16 (about A$25.43 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) (Jan to Mar, Nov, Dec), €18 (about A$28.60 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) (Apr, Oct), €22 (about A$34.96 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) (May, Jun, Sep), €24 (about A$38.14 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) (Jul, Aug). Closed 25 December and 1 January. No photography inside the cave; no pets.
